source_row.rationale: Oral potassium chloride can cause significant GI irritation, including nausea, vomiting, and even ulceration in some cases. Taking the medication with food or a full glass of water helps reduce this irritation. Extended-release tablets/capsules should generally be swallowed whole, not chewed or crushed, unless specifically indicated otherwise.
